categories.label: Staking
categories.how: Staked and held, not used anywhere else.
categories.payer: The Ethereum protocol (issuance), plus priority fees and MEV.

categories.label: Restaking
categories.how: Staked ETH that also secures other services (EigenLayer, Symbiotic), held and not used anywhere else.
categories.payer: Staking income plus service fees and token incentives from the restaking platform, its services and the issuer.

categories.label: Leveraged staking
categories.how: Staked ETH looped against borrowed ETH on lending markets, private and product.
categories.payer: The gap between the staking yield and the ETH borrow rate, paid by staking; ETH lenders take the borrow rate.

categories.label: Carry
categories.how: The part of products open for deposits where ETH is collateral for a dollar loan.
categories.payer: Dollar borrowers and stablecoin issuers on the parked dollars, minus the dollar borrow rate; often token rewards.

categories.label: Fixed yield
categories.how: A staked-ETH token split into principal and yield (Pendle, Spectra); the principal side locks in a rate.
categories.payer: Buyers of the yield side, who pay up front for the future staking yield and points.

categories.label: Basis
categories.how: Hold ETH and short ETH perpetuals or futures, paid in ETH. Ethena is not counted: its depositors hold dollars, not ETH; its ETH basis leg was $94M in May 2026 and all its crypto basis about $39M in July.
categories.payer: Traders who pay funding to be long.

categories.label: Options
categories.how: Sell call or put options on ETH and collect the premium.

categories.label: Credit
categories.how: Lend ETH to named borrowers (market makers, funds) or cover their credit risk; counted as supplied, lent out included.

categories.label: Farming and pools
categories.how: DEX, perp and bridge pools (the ETH side that no other row counts), managed strategy vaults and points programmes.
categories.payer: Traders (fees), borrowers in the venues the vault lends to, and token incentives.

categories.label: Money markets
categories.how: ETH and staking tokens posted in lending markets outside loops and carry products: mostly collateral for dollar loans by unknown wallets, off by default as in the BTC map.
categories.payer: The staking yield on staking tokens posted as collateral; plain WETH not lent out earns nothing. We do not know who holds it or what the loans fund.

categories.label: CDP collateral
categories.how: ETH and staking tokens posted to mint a stablecoin (Sky, Liquity, crvUSD).
categories.payer: Nobody for plain ETH; staking tokens keep their staking yield.
